description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source project. It serves as a server-side handler for dynamic building of a hierarchical project structure, returning JSON-encoded nodes for an Ext JS tree component. It manages navigation data for test projects, test suites, and test cases, supporting AJAX requests to load project tree nodes with details like node type, hierarchy, and associated test case counts.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: A class to interact with the database, notably retrieving table names.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Generates a list of child nodes for a given parent node, building the structure needed for the Ext JS tree component, including node type, hierarchy info, and test case counts.

methods.name: getAllTCasesID
methods.description: Recursively fetches all test case IDs under specified project or suite nodes, populating the provided array.
